description: Marks a sender's domain as a data source whose email Sergio reads and files, as Data Sources does: domain is the sender's domain; action 'preview' returns the leads its recent mail would produce and writes nothing; action 'tick' (the default) adds it; action 'untick' stops reading it. purpose says what it sends: 'booking_updates' (the default) or 'leads'. This is inbound only; nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first result.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_platform_sender
title: Add a data source, or stop reading one
